intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Warner Robins for 2026, and here is what he found: 7 family events, 6 of them free. The magic runs from November 22 (Planes and Trains Model Railroad Display at the Museum of Aviation) through December 29 (Festival of Trees at the Museum of Aviation), with the Warner Robins Christmas Tree Lighting at Perkins Park (December 1), the Warner Robins Christmas Parade (December 5), Byron Christmas Parade (December 5), the Centerville Annual Lighted Christmas Parade (December 5) and Animal Pictures with Santa (December 6) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Warner Robins

  • 7 Christmas events for kids in Warner Robins
  • 6 free events, including the Planes and Trains Model Railroad Display, the Festival of Trees, the Warner Robins Christmas Tree Lighting, the Warner Robins Christmas Parade and the Byron and Centerville parades
  • Meet Santa: Santa at the Planes and Trains Model Railroad Display (November 27), Animal Pictures with Santa (December 6) and the Centerville parade pre-event Santa letters (December 5)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Warner Robins Christmas Tree Lighting (December 1), the Warner Robins Christmas Parade, the Byron Christmas Parade and the Centerville Annual Lighted Christmas Parade (all December 5)
  • Trains: the Planes and Trains Model Railroad Display at the Museum of Aviation (November 22 to 29) and a trackless train at the tree lighting (December 1)
  • Season: November 22 to December 29

Planning a bigger day out? Warner Robins families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Macon, which covers Macon Christmas Light Extravaganza, Marche de Noel and the Nutcracker of Middle Georgia.
